name: Dropa
source:
Representative of the male Sirens on Slusland. Although his sisters often pick on him, he remains cheerful and easy-going. He has a strong sex drive, and because he knows little of customs beyond the island, he has very little sense of shame.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
